meta.name: deeptools
meta.description: NGS analysis toolkit. BAM to bigWig conversion, QC (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), heatmaps/profiles (TSS, peaks), for ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, ATAC-seq visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将高通量测序数据转化为可视化分析图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在分析ChIP-seq、RNA-seq或ATAC-seq数据
copy.tagline_en: Transform high-throughput sequencing data into visualization and analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if analyzing ChIP-seq, RNA-seq, or ATAC-seq data

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你分析基因测序数据:把 BAM 文件转成 bigWig 覆盖度轨道,做质量控制(相关性、PCA、指纹图),并生成 TSS 或峰区周围的热图和谱图,通过调用 deepTools 命令行工具完成。
howto.when: 当你说到 BAM、bigWig 等测序文件,或要求做格式转换、质量控制、绘制热图/谱图,或分析 ChIP-seq/RNA-seq/ATAC-seq 数据时触发。

say.text: 把 sample.bam 转成 bigWig,用 RPGC 标准化。
画 TSS 周围 3kb 的 ChIP 信号热图。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can analyze NGS sequencing data: convert BAM to bigWig coverage tracks, run quality control (correlation, PCA, fingerprints), and generate heatmaps/profiles around TSS or peaks by invoking deepTools command-line tools.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention BAM, bigWig, or BED files in a genomics context, or request format conversion, quality control, heatmap/profile plotting, or ChIP-seq/RNA-seq/ATAC-seq analysis.

say_en.text: Convert sample.bam to bigWig using RPGC normalization.
Compare two samples with multiBamSummary and plotCorrelation.
Plot ChIP signal heatmap around TSS in a 3kb window.
